scope: Candidate inputs, not release support claims. Ubuntu and Fedora are two distinct general-purpose Linux families on each Linux architecture. Alpine is a separate small diagnostic input.
downloadPolicy: Only explicit artifact IDs are downloaded; SHA-256 is mandatory and no floating substitution is permitted. Missing required input fails.
